Saca todo el ruido; la voz puede sonar u: Removes all the noise; the voice may sound a little less natural.
Sale con el diseño, el logo y el fondo d: Comes out with the episode's layout, logo and background, in 16:9. It's the image pub sends to Instagram with the full episode.
Sale en tu página y en Spotify / Apple P: Shown on your page and on Spotify / Apple Podcasts.
Salir sin terminar el evento (sigue abie: Leave without ending the event (stays open for the audience)
Se anotan con su nombre y hasta 3 pregun: They sign up with their name and up to 3 questions. You accept them and decide the order.
Se cierra un momento y vuelve a abrirse: It closes for a moment and reopens already updated.
Se cortó la conexión con la sala: The connection to the room was lost
Se cortó la conexión. Reanudando desde d: Connection lost. Resuming from where it left off…
Se crea en prePod con tu usuario como du: It's created in prePod with your user as owner. Logo, colors and page are set later in “Set up podcast”.
Se desconecta a todos y se cierra la sal: Everyone is disconnected and the room closes. If it was recorded, the recording is sent to postPod.
Se escribe la transcripción otra vez y s: The transcript is written again and the corrections you made by hand to the text are lost. Takes a few minutes. Reels with their own text don't change.
Se escribe otra vez el texto de este ree: This reel's text is written again and the corrections you made to it are lost. The episode doesn't change.
Se exporta el reel tal como lo ves ahora: The reel is exported as you see it now, vertical and with subtitles.
Se graba en tu Mac y se sube mientras ha: Recorded on your Mac and uploaded while you talk. You can lower it, but not raise it above what the test allowed.
Se habilita cuando todos los conductores: Enabled when all hosts in the room mark Ready
Se oye al instante mientras suena; lo qu: Heard instantly while playing; what you hear is what gets exported.
Se puede traer cuando esté listo en la w: Can be brought over once it's ready on the web
Segundos: negativo = suena antes, positi: Seconds: negative = plays earlier, positive = later
Separa la voz de todo lo demás —teclas,: Separates the voice from everything else —keyboard, dog, street, fan— and leaves everyone at an even volume
Separando la voz del ruido: Separating the voice from the noise
Si alguien usa el aire para algo indebid: If someone misuses the air: their audio and video are cut instantly
Si cierras thePod se detiene tu grabació: If you quit thePod your recording stops. What was recorded stays on your Mac and finishes uploading the next time you open prod.
Si en «Fuerte» se come consonantes (p, t: If “Strong” eats consonants (p, t, k), go back to Normal.
Si quitaste silencios, se vuelven a busc: If you removed silences, they're searched again with the new timings. For a single reel: Deliver → Reels → Subtitles.
Sin audífonos, pide al invitado que habl: Without headphones, ask the guest to speak. If they hear themselves, there's echo. Then compare the two recordings of your voice:

Sin imagen se usa el color: Without an image the color is used
Without a logo the title's initial is shown.

Only "%@" changes. The other reels keep the shared settings.

Solo: se oye solo esta persona: Solo: only this person is heard
Sonido de estudio aplicado (vale para el: Studio sound applied (applies to the episode and all reels).
Sonido de thePod al cerrar la app: thePod sound when quitting the app
Sonido y animación de thePod al abrir la: thePod sound and animation when opening the app
Sonoridad de la mezcla mientras suena (e: Loudness of the mix while playing (estimated by summing the tracks at their volume, with K filter). The exact measurement is made on export.
Sonoridad integrada: el volumen percibid: Integrated loudness: the perceived volume of the whole episode, as the platforms measure it. Each one brings it to its target on playback; delivering it already on target avoids them raising it (more noise) or lowering it.

Sumar lo que duran las secciones anterio: Add up the duration of the previous sections
